name: Ceramic Lining

content_html:
Ceramic Lining

Extreme-wear Alumina (Al2O3) ceramic tile and cylinder lining systems manufactured and installed by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia to eliminate destructive erosion and sliding abrasion in heavy material handling equipment. Engineered with high-purity (92% or 95%) sinter-molded alumina ceramics, our linings provide an diamond-hard surface (Mohs hardness 9) that outperforms abrasion-resistant steel plates (AR400/AR500) by up to 10 times in high-velocity particulate environments.

Available as weldable ceramic tiles with steel insert caps, rubber-backed ceramic composite panels, or custom-shaped curved pipe sleeves for seamless elbow and cyclone protection.

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

To specify ceramic wear lining for your plant, provide your equipment drawings (chute, hopper, cyclone, or pipe spool), material dropped (coal, clinker, iron ore, silica sand, gold slurry), particle drop height, and working temperature. Our technical team designs custom layout drawings with staggered joint patterns and recommends epoxy adhesive vs weld-through attachment.
quote_checklist: Wear area and dimensions (chute, cyclone, pipe bend, hopper)
Material handled, particle size and flow velocity
Current wear life or failure problem
Workshop or on-site work, and location
